changelog: V1.9: WhatsApp Reminder button renamed to WhatsApp Wada inside the full-screen alarm.
V1.9: WhatsApp Wada now opens the active customer chat with a pre-filled Wada reminder message.
V1.9: Wada WhatsApp message uses the correct customer name, normalized phone, balance/amount, date, time and note.
V1.9: Prevented stale Party/Wada IDs from sending a previous customer's reminder.
V1.9: WhatsApp Wada tested with app open, app closed, locked device and screen off.
V1.9: Preserved existing exact Wada alarm, snooze, payment and completion logic.
V1.9: Added smooth premium 3D-style popup confirmations for full-screen Wada actions.
V1.9: Payment Received success popup displays the recorded amount.
V1.9: Partial Payment popup confirms the saved partial amount.
V1.9: 30-minute and 1-hour snooze popups confirm the selected delay.
V1.9: Custom Time and Tomorrow 10 AM popups confirm rescheduled reminder time.
V1.9: WhatsApp Wada and Not Received actions now show matching feedback popups.
V1.9: Action popups support Urdu/English and Light/Dark/Midnight themes.
V1.9: Added non-blocking popup animations, automatic dismissal and duplicate-popup prevention.
V1.9: Updated visible app version labels to V1.9 while keeping application ID and signing unchanged.
V1.9: Real-device Wada/action and complete upgrade regression tests passed.
V1.8: Refactored the large inline application script into dedicated modular JavaScript files.
V1.8: Organized shared code in core.js and separated navigation, party, ledger, dashboard and cash modules.
V1.8: Separated Wada, reminder card, stock, PDF, AI, backup, profile, update and download counter modules.
V1.8: Separated contact integration and Android native bridge/image picker from inline HTML.
V1.8: Moved reusable theme/UI styling into css/app.css and removed obsolete duplicate inline code.
V1.8: Kept app initialization and module load order stable after modularization.
V1.8: Fixed Party screen All and Lena Hai filters and improved search/list state restoration.
V1.8: Improved alphabetical Party sorting and completed-party placement.
V1.8: Improved Add/Edit Customer, supplier form, duplicate-phone handling and photo attachments.
V1.8: Improved native contact selection with Pakistani 03xx/92xx/+92 number normalization.
V1.8: Kept legacy supplier opening balances compatible without repeating migration changes.
V1.8: Improved Ledger entries, balance calculations, payment-method chips and report CSV export.
V1.8: Improved Dashboard summaries, wallet breakdowns, charts and cash/daily closing screens.
V1.8: Fixed Party Report Print, PDF and WhatsApp action routing and duplicate action handlers.
V1.8: Improved selectable/vector-text PDF output for ledger, reports and share workflows.
V1.8: Improved PDF saving and WhatsApp file sharing on real Android devices.
V1.8: Moved PDF Base64 decoding and file I/O off the Android main thread for smoother performance.
V1.8: Lazy-loaded PDF libraries when needed to improve app startup speed.
V1.8: Improved offline startup and non-blocking Google Fonts loading with fallbacks.
V1.8: Optimized Stock data caching, item rendering, orders and inventory recalculation.
V1.8: Improved stock changes, product images, item details and order handling.
V1.8: Improved Stock backup/restore coverage for quantities, images and order history.
V1.8: Improved local/SAF/Google Drive backup and restore handling with validation and safety snapshots.
V1.8: Added a separate six-digit recovery PIN process for forgotten four-digit app PINs.
V1.8: Recovery flow preserves business data and does not bypass normal app unlock.
V1.8: Improved exact native Wada alarm scheduling, rescheduling and cancellation on edit/delete.
V1.8: Improved alarms while app is closed, phone is locked and during battery idle/Doze.
V1.8: Improved overlapping-alarm queueing, notification tap navigation and reminder statuses.
V1.8: Preserved Wada selected tones, snooze and receive/missed actions.
V1.8: Updated payment reminder JPG card layout to 1080 x 1350 and removed old overrides.
V1.8: Improved personalized reminder templates, business details and WhatsApp/SMS sharing.
V1.8: Improved shop logo/branding helpers and consistent branding across the app and reports.
V1.8: Improved Android image picking, compression, keyboard handling and screen insets.
V1.8: Improved app update/version display and GitHub download counter separation.
V1.8: Refined card spacing, corner radii, buttons, form fields and bottom-sheet safe-area padding.
V1.8: Improved dropdown readability, Urdu/English labels and Light/Dark/Midnight contrast.
V1.8: Verified data-preserving update install, cold start, backup, PDF, WhatsApp and all main screens.
Earlier updates: Improved Shop/Business Profile save confirmation and editable reminder-card shop tagline.
Earlier updates: Required valid customer phone numbers and improved Pakistani phone number validation.
Earlier updates: Fixed contact picker display, customer search, A-Z sorting and keyboard overlap.
Earlier updates: Added Wada alarm tune selection and improved OTA update checking.
Earlier updates: Improved account-clear/payment reminder cards, shop logo and account title.
Earlier updates: Improved Stock backup, Party Ledger PDFs and WhatsApp report delivery.
Earlier updates: Reduced duplicate reminder notifications and improved live GitHub download count.
